title: VideoPopy - AI 3D Breakout Video Generator
excerpt: Create AI 3D breakout videos from prompts or product ideas for Reels, Shorts, Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook.
content_html:
AI 3D breakout videos

Make your content
break out of the frame.

VideoPopy is an AI 3D breakout video generator for short videos where your subject moves into dimensional space, then test the concept across Reels, Instagram and Shorts without a traditional production workflow.

Start free - 10 credits Watch examples

No subscription No credit card 5s and 10s clips

Prompt-to-video workflow•Platform crops for Reels, Shorts, Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook•Credit pricing with 10 free starter credits

How it works

Four steps to a test-ready clip

A guided workflow from source idea to platform preview.

1

Describe or upload

Type an idea or drop a product photo. Our AI enhances it into a 3D-ready prompt.

2

Pick platform & layout

Reels, Instagram, Shorts, LinkedIn - we auto-frame and preview it in a real feed.

3

Craft the breakout

Choose Auto or Director mode. Watch subjects leap out of the frame in true 3D.

4

Download & share

Grab platform-optimized exports, ready-to-paste captions, and hashtags.

Why VideoPopy

Built for faster social creative testing

More focused than general AI tools. More flexible than fixed templates.

Signature 3D breakout

A focused pop-out effect for testing product reveals, campaign hooks, and frame-breaking motion.

Fast first drafts

Move from an idea to a platform-ready clip without a traditional shoot. Timing varies by model and service load.

Social-first workflow

Captions, hashtags, aspect ratios & feed previews for every platform - all in one guided flow.

Fair credit pricing

No subscriptions. $1 = 10 credits, $5 minimum, 10 free to start. You only pay for what you make.

Examples

See the breakout in action

Prompt examples for products, creators, and social campaigns.

Browse the gallery

Use cases

Plan the clip before you generate it

Product launch clips

Turn one product benefit into a focused 3D reveal, comparison, or offer-led short video.

Product launch clips guide

Short-form SEO assets

Convert search questions, FAQ answers, and blog sections into social clips that support organic discovery.

Short-form SEO assets guide

Prompt testing workflow

Create prompt families for hooks, camera motion, product proof, and platform-specific variants.

Prompt testing workflow guide

Pricing

Simple credits. No surprises.

$1 = 10 credits. A typical 5s clip costs ~4 credits. Start with 10 free.

FAQ

Questions, answered

What is the 3D breakout effect?+

It's a visual technique where your subject appears to move out of the video frame toward the viewer, creating depth and motion parallax for an attention-focused creative test. We achieve it with advanced prompting and smart model routing.

Do I need a subscription?+

No. VideoPopy is pure pay-as-you-go. $1 = 10 credits, minimum $5, and every new account starts with 10 free credits.

Which platforms are supported?+

Instagram Reels & Feed, X, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn and Facebook - with auto aspect ratios, captions and hashtags for each.

How long does a video take?+

Typically under 60 seconds for a 5s / 720p clip and under 2 minutes for 10s / 1080p.

Do I own the videos I create?+

Yes. You retain ownership of everything you generate and can download original + platform-optimized exports anytime.

FAQ

问题，已解答

What is the 3D breakout effect?+

这是一种视觉技术，您的主题似乎从视频帧移向观看者，为注意力集中的创意测试创造深度和运动视差。 我们通过高级提示和智能模型路由来实现这一目标。

Do I need a subscription?+

不会。VideoPopy 是纯粹的按需付费的。 1 美元 = 10 个积分，最低 5 美元，每个新帐户开始时都有 10 个免费积分。

Which platforms are supported?+

Instagram Reels & Feed、X、YouTube Shorts、LinkedIn 和 Facebook - 每个都有自动宽高比、标题和主题标签。

How long does a video take?+

通常，5 秒/720p 剪辑的时间不超过 60 秒，10 秒/1080p 剪辑的时间通常不超过 2 分钟。

Do I own the videos I create?+

是的。 您保留对生成的所有内容的所有权，并可以随时下载原始+平台优化的导出。
